turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Hi! How can I help you today?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: hi there

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: I would like to know the status of my order

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Sure.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: What part of the status?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: I'm unable to access my account cause I lost my 2FA

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I see.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: what to know what status is the delivery

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: You have a lot of issues I see!

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Lets first get you that 2FA.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: okay

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: What is your full name or account ID?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Joyce Wu

turns.speaker: system
turns.text: Account has been pulled up for Joyce Wu.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Great, now I need your email address to reset the code.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: joycew72@email.com

turns.speaker: system
turns.text: Details of joycew72@email.com have been entered.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Great, I have reset the code and sent the new one to the email on file.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Okay. Thanks

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: For the future, I am going to also send you a link about best security practices.

turns.speaker: system
turns.text: A link will be sent.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Thanks for that

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: You're welcome.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I don't want to hold you much longer so lets get this delivery time.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: What is your account ID and order ID?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: I dont have that till I log into my account

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Oh, are you able to log in or do you need to contact us again later?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Would contact you if I do encounter any issue

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Great, we appreciate your business and have a good day!

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: thanks
